purpose: Cleaned, typed runway reference data from the OurAirports bronze landing: one row per runway (10,760 rows) with its airport linkage, physical dimensions, surface, lighting and closure status, and per-end (low-end/high-end) identifiers, coordinates, elevations, headings, and displaced thresholds. Feeds airport infrastructure analytics and joins to the airports silver table via airport_ref or airport_ident.
usage: Join to airports on airport_ref (integer) or airport_ident (code); each runway_id is unique and forms the grain. Filter closed = TRUE deliberately when analyzing active runways only. Expect nulls in per-end geometry columns (~22-28% null for coordinates, elevations, and headings) and treat displaced-threshold nulls as absence of a displaced threshold rather than missing data.
limitations: Displaced-threshold columns are ~88-90% null and coordinate/elevation/heading columns are ~22-28% null; no values were imputed. The surface column is uncontrolled free text with 239 distinct spellings and was not normalized. he_heading_degt contains at least one out-of-range value (max 362.0) and le_ident/he_ident include placeholder values like '.' and '-'; these were retained as landed for the reviewer to assess.
